nodes.author: realray8080
nodes.text:
What is the treatment of Human metapneumovirus🦠 HMPV.
 
There is no any anti-viral medications that treat HMPV.
Most people manage their symptoms at home until they get better. 
But if you or your children are severe ill you might admit to the hospital 🏥.

nodes.author: realray8080
nodes.text:
How  human metapneumovirus🦠 is transmitted. 

HMPV is mostly transmitted through direct contact with someone who has  it or from touching things contaminated with virus. Below is the  ways.
🦠coughing and sneezing .
🦠shaking hands, hugging  or kissing.
🦠touching surface.

nodes.author: realray8080
nodes.text:
How mostly Human metapneumovirus HMPV Affects. 
 
1. Mostly Affects childrens age below 5 years 
2. Also Affects adults aged above years 
3. People with weakened immune system from condition like HIV  and cancer.
4. Those with asthma.

nodes.author: realray8080
nodes.text:
What did human metapneumovirus🦠 HMPV affect.

The virus 🦠 it often cause  the effect on upper respiratory system  but also it can cause the lower respiratory infection like pneumonia  and asthma.
This virus is commonly in the winter and early spring.

nodes.author: realray8080
nodes.text:
SYMPTOMS  of HMPV
🩸Cough and wheezing .
🩸Runny or stuff nose.
🩸Sore throat .
🩸Shortness of breathing .
🩸Severe fever .
🩸Skin rash.
